channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Anthropic is reported to pitch investors on an IPO worth up to $2 trillion
item.description: Anthropic met institutional investors in San Francisco ahead of a listing reportedly targeted before Thanksgiving.

item.title: Xbox surveys players on making Minecraft, Fallout and more console exclusive
item.description: A Microsoft survey asks Xbox Insiders how they would react if big franchises left PlayStation and Nintendo consoles.

item.title: Netflix releases the first trailer for Greta Gerwig's Narnia film
item.description: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew hits cinemas worldwide on February 12, 2027, before streaming on Netflix in April.

item.title: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo foldable opens for preorders on October 16
item.description: Apple's first foldable iPhone goes on sale October 23, and Apple is reported to have raised orders by 30%.

item.title: OpenAI recorder case: prosecutors say a linked chatbot account asked how to build bugs
item.description: New details say an account tied to the charged engineer asked about hidden audio recorders days before the device was planted.

item.title: EU opens its first AI Act enforcement test with requests to OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description: The EU's AI Office sent formal information requests after lab tests in which AI models reached outside systems.

item.title: Rockstar says staff can have a union, and its next game won't take eight years
item.description: In a Bloomberg feature on GTA 6, Rockstar leaders spoke about union talks and a faster pace for future games.

item.title: Google widens Gemini 4 Argon to subscribers and businesses
item.description: Google's new flagship model is rolling out to AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, enterprises and paid developers.

item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse launches today after strong reviews
item.description: Konami's new 2D Castlevania arrives on October 15 for $29.99, with an 86 Metacritic score reported before launch.

item.title: Marvel's VisionQuest premieres on Disney+ to mostly positive reviews
item.description: Paul Bettany returns as Vision, with James Spader's Ultron, in an eight-episode Disney+ series.

item.title: Character.ai files for bankruptcy as Disney lines up a $20 million deal
item.description: The AI companion startup filed for Chapter 11 protection, citing legal and operational pressures.

item.title: Apple unveils the $299 HomeView hub, a new HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K
item.description: Apple refreshed its smart home lineup on October 13 with a 7-inch HomeView display, HomePod mini 2 and a faster Apple TV.

item.title: CoreWeave shares slide as its bond yields touch 15%
item.description: The AI cloud company's stock fell sharply as investors worried about the debt behind the AI data center boom.

item.title: Ubisoft plans to close RedLynx and cut 70 jobs at Ubisoft Singapore
item.description: Up to 122 jobs are affected as Ubisoft continues a year of cost cuts, cancelled games and studio closures.

item.title: Street Fighter punches into cinemas on October 16
item.description: Paramount's live-action film, with Jason Momoa and Noah Centineo, is tracking for a $25 to $35 million opening.

item.title: AI agents built a full Chrome exploit that earned a $250,000 Google bounty
item.description: Security firm XBOW says agents running OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol chained three bugs in six days for about $40,000 in compute.

item.title: Apple is reported to launch its first AI features in China in December
item.description: Bloomberg says Apple Intelligence will reach mainland China with iOS 27.3, built with Alibaba, without the new Siri.

item.title: OpenAI says a former staffer took device files with him to Apple
item.description: In a court filing, OpenAI alleges the employee moved over 100 confidential files on an unreleased device before rejoining Apple.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4's campaign early access starts October 16
item.description: Digital pre-order buyers can play the campaign a week before the October 23 launch on PS5, Xbox, PC and Switch 2.

item.title: Six Canadian news publishers sue Anthropic over scraped articles
item.description: The Toronto Star, Globe and Mail, Postmedia and Canadian Press are among those suing in an Ontario court.

item.title: Cisco warns attackers are exploiting a critical email security flaw
item.description: A 9.8-severity bug in Cisco Secure Email Gateway can let an attacker write files and possibly run commands as root.

item.title: GTA 6 on PC is reported for the first three months of 2027
item.description: GamesBeat says Rockstar plans a PC release a few months after the November 19 console launch.

item.title: Meta says hackers took code and data on about 1,500 people from its GitHub
item.description: Attackers used an employee's stolen login to reach some Meta code repositories, the company says.

item.title: Amazon is reported in talks to buy AI video startup Decart for about $7 billion
item.description: The Wall Street Journal says Amazon is negotiating for Decart, whose models generate live video and interactive worlds.

item.title: FBI raids over 40 Texas homes in a North Korean remote IT worker scheme
item.description: The Justice Department says North Korean workers posed as US staff at about 70 companies in 16 states and DC.

item.title: Microsoft unveils the $49.99 Xbox Nano, a pocket-sized controller
item.description: The smallest Xbox controller yet is just over five inches long and ships in select markets in November.

item.title: ASML lifts its 2026 forecast and adds 30% capacity as AI demand grows
item.description: The chip equipment maker posted record third-quarter sales and still expects supply shortfalls.

item.title: YouTube Music adds labels for AI-generated songs
item.description: Tracks will be tagged Fully Gen AI, Partly Gen AI or No Gen AI, but AI songs stay in recommendations.

item.title: Anthropic open-sources Scion, its own Git replacement built with Claude
item.description: Anthropic says daily code merges jumped from about 2,500 to over 30,000, so it built a new version control system.

item.title: More than 400 scientists call for an international AI regulator
item.description: Geoffrey Hinton and Yoshua Bengio led the letter, which asks for frontier models to be air-gapped during testing.

item.title: Below and Ben Affleck's Animals top Netflix's charts in their first weeks
item.description: Below drew 17.0 million views and Animals 23.8 million, while Ice Age films filled half the English film top 10.

item.title: Other Mommy opens at No. 1 with $27.5 million
item.description: The Jessica Chastain horror film took $27.5 million on a $19 million budget despite a D+ audience grade.

item.title: GlobalFoundries will run two new New York chip plants funded by Japan
item.description: Up to $21 billion in Japanese money will build two 300mm fabs at Malta, New York, with the US taking a small stake.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Season 5 launches with Las Vegas maps and joins Game Pass
item.description: The new season and the game's Game Pass debut both arrived on October 13, ten days before Modern Warfare 4.

item.title: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy's Sacrifice comes to Netflix on October 16
item.description: The apocalyptic comedy-thriller leads a busy week of new streaming films.

item.title: Amazon's new Alexa tablets go on sale in the US from $230
item.description: Three Alexa Tablet models arrived in the US, Mexico and Canada on October 14, with Europe following on October 19.

item.title: Taylor Swift becomes the first solo act with 100 weeks at No. 1
item.description: The Life of a Showgirl spent a 14th week atop the Billboard 200, leaving only the Beatles ahead of her on the all-time list.

item.title: Fox releases the first trailer for its Baywatch reboot, premiering in January
item.description: Stephen Amell leads the new 12-episode Baywatch, with some original cast members returning as guests.
